channel.title: AI Blocks: new and changed skills, workflows and minds
channel.description: The newest free AI skills, workflows, prompts, agents and minds on AI Blocks, and the ones that changed most recently.

item.title: Buyer can act check
item.description: Give it what you sell and the link. You learn if a buyer can get it today, and what to do if not.
item.category: Check ads before they go live

item.title: Claim source trace
item.description: Give it your draft and your sources. Every fact gets a dated source, a rewrite or a cut.

item.title: Client's-eye check
item.description: Give it your brief, the finished work and your facts. A fresh reviewer reads it as your client and lists fixes.

item.title: Make an ad concept spread
item.description: Give it your ad brief and product facts. You get nine or more ideas, the best ones made, and one lead ad.

item.title: Make three design directions
item.description: Give it your design brief and brand file. You get three different directions made at real size, with one chosen.

item.title: Make three first screens
item.description: Give it your page brief and brand file. You get three different first screens as real pages, with one chosen.
item.category: Write and build a landing page

item.title: Outside chooser
item.description: Give it two to four options and your brief. A fresh reviewer picks one and says what to borrow.

item.title: Three series arcs
item.description: Give it your email brief and facts. You get three plans for the series, each with its first email, and one chosen.

item.title: Two plan shapes
item.description: Give it your question, budget and numbers. You get two differently shaped one-page plans with money and dates, and one pick.

item.title: Brand file capture
item.description: Give it your website. You get a brand file your AI keeps current: prices, look, voice and facts, each with its source and date.

item.title: Expert agent eval builder
item.description: Give it your agent files. You get a rubric in your words, 20 or more test cases and a judge that grades like you.
item.category: Set up AI to work for you

item.title: Grounded job protocol
item.description: Give it any real job. Your AI studies your business, makes real options and gets the work checked.

item.title: Ambition planner
item.description: Give it your task or prompt. Get the goal behind it, an expert-level plan, a pass check and a rewritten prompt.
item.category: Set up AI to work for you

item.title: Cold call script writer
item.description: Tell it what you sell and who you call. Get a cold call script: opener, questions, replies to brush-offs and a voicemail.

item.title: Etsy shop opening planner
item.description: Say what you make and who buys it. Get a plan for your Etsy shop: listings, photos, price check and launch steps.

item.title: Accessibility auditor
item.description: Audit a web page or app for accessibility barriers. Get findings tied to WCAG 2.2, a test plan for keyboard and screen readers, and a fix list.

item.title: Aging parent care coordinator
item.description: Keep an aging parent's medicines, appointments and care team straight. Get a care plan, who to tell about what, and questions for the doctor.

item.title: AI document search planner
item.description: Plan an AI that answers from your own documents. Get how to split and search them, plus a question set to score each change.

item.title: AI feature planner
item.description: Get a plan to add an AI feature to your product, from data check to launch, with bias tests, monitoring and a retraining trigger.

item.title: API platform engineer agent
item.description: Describe your API (how other software connects to yours). Get its rules, changes that would break users, and a plan for versions and limits.

item.title: API test planner
item.description: Share your API spec (how other software talks to yours). Get a test plan with edge cases, sign-in checks, failure cases and starter test code.

item.title: China ecommerce operations planner
item.description: Get a China ecommerce plan for Taobao, Tmall, JD, Pinduoduo or Douyin Shop, with margin checks, ad plans and a 618 or Double 11 countdown.

item.title: China market localization planner
item.description: Turn China trend data into a market entry brief with platform picks, content templates and a week-by-week launch checklist for a small team.

item.title: Claude Code learning coach
item.description: Check what you have tried in Claude Code and find your gaps. Get a short practice plan from a quick or deeper experience check.

item.title: Compliance auditor agent
item.description: Check your security setup against a standard such as SOC 2, ISO 27001 or HIPAA. Get a gap table, proof list and fix order.

item.title: Content writer
item.description: Get a content plan and channel drafts from one idea: blog, video and social posts, each with its audience goal and facts to check. Bring your topic.

item.title: Cross-border ecommerce planner
item.description: Get a cross-border ecommerce plan for Amazon, Shopee, Temu or TikTok Shop with margin per product, compliance to-dos and a launch order.

item.title: Data pipeline designer
item.description: Get a data pipeline design with raw, cleaned and report-ready layers, quality checks, freshness targets, alerts and a plan for when loads fail.

item.title: Drone mapping specialist
item.description: Plan a drone mapping job: flight settings, ground control points, processing steps and accuracy checks for orthomosaics, terrain models and 3D meshes.

item.title: Game economy designer
item.description: Get a game economy plan with each currency's sources and sinks, a 90-day balance check for four player types, and the numbers to track.

item.title: Geoprocessing specialist agent
item.description: Turn a repeat ArcGIS Pro task into a Python script, toolbox or Model Builder model. Get a build plan with parameters, checks and a draft script.

item.title: GIS solution designer
item.description: Plan a working GIS demo or proof of concept: what it must show, the simplest tools, build steps, a safe backup and what is not production ready.

item.title: Image prompt engineer agent
item.description: Describe the photo you want. Get an image prompt that sets subject, light, camera and style, plus a leave-out list, for Midjourney, DALL-E or Flux.

item.title: Implementation brief writer
item.description: Turn a software change into a written implementation plan with risks, files to change, test steps and a rollback path. No code is written.

item.title: Incident response coordinator
item.description: Get a clear severity call, roles, update messages and a blameless post-mortem for a tech outage. Bring the timeline, alerts and who is on call.

item.title: Instagram content planner
item.description: Get a 30-day Instagram plan with a look guide, a 9-post grid, Reels and Stories ideas and hashtags. Bring your brand and goal.

item.title: Knowledge graph engineer
item.description: Turn your documents into a knowledge graph design with linked facts, source tracking and test queries. Bring your files and your questions.

item.title: LinkedIn content writer
item.description: Get a LinkedIn voice profile, three content pillars, a 30-day calendar and post drafts with three hook options each. Bring your goal and stories.

item.title: Map designer
item.description: Get a map design plan with base map, colour scheme, symbols, labels, legend and layout for print or web, plus a colour blindness check.

item.title: Merger integration manager
item.description: Plan your first 100 days after buying or merging with a business. Get a Day 1 checklist, workstream owners, dependencies and the risks to watch.

item.title: Outbound sales planner
item.description: Get an outbound sales plan: who to target, which buying signals to watch and a multi-channel message sequence with draft emails you can send.

item.title: Payments and billing engineer agent
item.description: Plan a Stripe, Adyen, Braintree or PayPal build with no double charges, safe webhooks, a small card-data footprint and daily reconciliation.

item.title: Playful interface designer
item.description: Get three to five playful touches for your product, such as 404 pages, loading lines and button labels, with accessibility and speed checks.

item.title: Reddit community planner
item.description: Get a Reddit plan: which subreddits to join, a rules and disclosure check for each, and helpful draft posts and replies. Bring your brand.

item.title: Release acceptance evidence reviewer
item.description: Get a launch readiness review of a finished build. It checks earlier QA claims against proof and returns FAILED, NEEDS WORK or READY.

item.title: Sales data consolidation planner
item.description: Turn your sales rows into one report by territory and rep, with quota attainment, pipeline by stage and top performers. Bring your sales table.
item.category: Analyse data and explain the results

item.title: Sales outreach writer
item.description: Write B2B cold outreach for one prospect: a personalized email, a 7-touch follow-up plan, replies to likely objections and the next step.

item.title: Search relevance engineer agent
item.description: Fix poor site search with a tested plan for Elasticsearch or OpenSearch, so each change is scored on real queries before it goes live.

item.title: Simulated user walkthrough reviewer
item.description: Share your web page and a visitor profile. See what that visitor thinks at each scroll, where they doubt or leave, and the fixes ranked.

item.title: Software architect
item.description: Choose how to structure your software, with at least two options, their trade-offs, a recommended design and a written decision record.

item.title: Software tool comparison planner
item.description: Choose between software tools with a scored comparison. Get your criteria, a trial plan, a cost view and a pick you can defend.

item.title: Spatial data engineer agent
item.description: Plan a pipeline that turns messy map data into clean, standard files, with coordinate fixes, field rules, quality checks and a repeatable run.

item.title: Spatial data scientist
item.description: Plan a spatial analysis, such as hot spots, clusters or location based prediction, with the right test, bias checks and plain language results.

item.title: Studio operations planner
item.description: Write step-by-step procedures and an operating plan for your small studio or team. Get who owns what, your tools and vendors, and a support routine.

item.title: Study abroad advisor agent
item.description: Plan your study abroad applications. Get a reach, target and safety school list, a dated timeline, an essay check and visa questions.

item.title: Test automation engineer agent
item.description: Get stable Playwright or Cypress browser tests, a CI setup and a fix for each flaky test, so failures mean real bugs and not bad timing.

item.title: TikTok content planner
item.description: Get a TikTok plan: content pillars, 10 video ideas with 3-second hooks, one test for each and the numbers to read. Bring your product and buyer.

item.title: UI designer agent
item.description: Get a UI design system for your product, with colours, type, spacing, buttons and forms in every state, dark mode and accessibility checks.

item.title: Unity software architect
item.description: Plan a Unity project structure with ScriptableObjects so systems stay separate, designers can edit data, and oversized scripts get split up.

item.title: Unreal gameplay systems engineer
item.description: Plan an Unreal Engine 5 gameplay feature in C++ and Blueprint. Get the code split, build setup and checks to run before you ship.

item.title: Visual story planner
item.description: Turn your message into a visual story plan, with the story arc, a frame-by-frame sequence of one message per frame and a version for each channel.

item.title: Web page structure designer
item.description: Get a page structure and CSS base for a new site, with section order, a layout grid, type and spacing scales and a light, dark and system theme toggle.

item.title: Website spec and screenshot checker
item.description: Share a website and its spec. Get a test report with screenshots, pass or fail results and a clear failed, not determined or ready call.

item.title: Workflow improvement reviewer
item.description: Improve one work process. Get a step map, ranked bottlenecks, what to automate and small tests to try, from your numbers.

item.title: Workflow specification writer
item.description: Turn a feature into a workflow spec with every path, failure, cleanup and test case written down before anyone builds it.
item.category: Write down how work gets done

item.title: X post and reply writer
item.description: Get a week of X (Twitter) posts, one thread and reply drafts for your account, plus a crisis reply plan. Bring your topic and sample posts.

item.title: Ad concept writer
item.description: Brainstorm 20 or more ad concepts in seven groups, then rank them and pick the top eight to produce. Built for planning your next ad tests.

item.title: Ad image planner
item.description: Plan a batch of ad images from your product photo: get the settings, a prompt for each version, edit requests and a log of every change.

item.title: Ad message sequence planner
item.description: Plan an ad structure around trigger, emotion, evidence and payoff. Get a video timeline or static layout brief for your product and buyer.

item.title: Ad photography style chooser
item.description: Choose the photo style for your ad. Get a main style, a style to test against it and one to avoid, plus shot notes for the shoot.

item.title: Ad production brief planner
item.description: Turn gaps in your ad mix into 5 to 10 ready-to-make creative briefs. Get a ranked queue a designer or creator can start on today.

item.title: Agent injection evidence review assistant
item.description: Get safe prompt injection test cases for your AI agent, a control gap list and retest records. Tests run only with the owner's written approval.

item.title: Avatar motion transfer planner
item.description: Share an approved avatar and owned performance clip. Get a motion-transfer plan, reference roles and checks for the result.

item.title: Backup communication plan builder
item.description: Build a backup communication plan with fallback paths, owners and switch triggers. Get a worksheet, check-in card and a safe test outline.

item.title: Brand ad remix designer
item.description: Share your own ads and real product photos. Get a new set in your brand style, with prompts, checks and a change log.

item.title: Brand enemy statement writer
item.description: Write a brand enemy statement from your customer reviews. You get a clear stance, a promise and a list of proof gaps to fill.

item.title: Brand image prompt writer
item.description: Turn your brand, scene, product and copy into one image prompt for an AI image tool, with a negative prompt and a model pick.

item.title: Build a research talk from checked figures
item.description: Attach a paper, result tables and talk length. Get traceable figures, slides and speaker notes for review.

item.title: Business data migration planner
item.description: Plan a business data move with field maps, test imports, final switch checks and a recovery plan.

item.title: Business tool launch reviewer
item.description: Check a business tool launch before go-live. Share your rollout plan and get a checklist, open blockers and a go or no-go record.

item.title: Buyer awareness ad planner
item.description: Pick the right ad copy structure for what your buyer already knows. Get a headline, body and CTA, plus a warning if the stage is wrong.

item.title: Buyer motivation and proof mapper
item.description: Find what makes a buyer start looking, how they feel, what proof they need and what result they want. Get a buyer trigger and proof map.

item.title: Buyer-stage ad theme planner
item.description: Map your buyers, their awareness stage and nine ad themes. Find gaps and get the ten best ad cells to make next, ranked.

item.title: Campaign copy writer
item.description: Get campaign copy checked against your approved claims. Every claim is tied to its proof, gaps are flagged and a checkpoint is saved.
item.category: Set up AI to work for you

item.title: Codebase learning planner
item.description: Turn a code folder into a study map. Get ordered phases, what to know first and 2 or 3 paths that fit your goal and level.

item.title: Coding project coach
item.description: Learn to code by building a real project. Your AI sets small milestones, gives hints and checks your code, and you write every line yourself.

item.title: Community needs research planner
item.description: Plan a community needs assessment: give your area and service idea, get a research plan, provider map and gap summary to show if the need is real.

item.title: Competitor ad theme and gap mapper
item.description: Sort competitor Meta ads into thirteen themes, see which lanes are crowded or open, and get ranked ad briefs to test next.

item.title: Customer message tone and urgency reviewer
item.description: Find out how upset a customer is and how fast to reply. Paste their message and get tone, urgency, churn signs and how to respond.

item.title: Debugging practice coach
item.description: Learn to debug your own code. Share the bug and what you tried, and this debugging practice coach guides you to find and prove the fix yourself.

item.title: Donated goods intake planner
item.description: Plan your donated goods intake: what to accept, how to grade, where each item goes, and a basic donor receipt. Built for thrift and resale stores.

item.title: Eight-lever ad visual planner
item.description: Set eight visual choices for an ad image, lock the ones that must stay and get three version previews that differ enough to test.

item.title: Five reasons landing page builder
item.description: Share product facts and an offer. Get a five-reasons HTML page, with a choice of looks and a Shopify file if needed.
item.category: Write and build a landing page

item.title: Five-angle ad headline writer
item.description: Write five ad headlines for one product, each with a different angle. You get character counts and a plan for which two to test first.

item.title: Five-part creator ad script writer
item.description: Write a creator video ad script in five parts, from hook to call to action. Get timed lines, delivery notes and a shot list.

item.title: Five-tactic ad hook writer
item.description: Write short ad hooks for your product with five tactics. Get 10 to 15 hooks, ranked, with the first ones to test and notes for filming.

item.title: Five-voice video opener writer
item.description: Write eighteen spoken video ad openers in five voices, with exact words and delivery notes, built only from your approved claims.

item.title: Foreplay ad strategy planner
item.description: Share your Foreplay ads. Get groups by ad type, notes on what they show and an HTML test brief.

item.title: Learning level checker
item.description: Find your real level in a technical topic. Answer a few short questions and get a starting level and first lesson to match.

item.title: Learning session handover writer
item.description: Turn your session notes into an updated learner profile and a handoff note, so your next learning session starts where this one stopped.
